summary: Ran backend smoke tests only, as requested: 11/11 passed. Covered health check, admin login, /auth/me (with and without a token), GET state for admin, a PUT then GET state round-trip on a new TEST_ user, webhook rejection of a bad URL, a real webhook call, TTS and TTS input validation. The TTS endpoint returns 200 audio/mpeg (about 7KB of real audio). No 500 and no regression from the defensive init change. There is no /api/tasks route; tasks live inside the state sync payload.
critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/state overwrites the stored state with no check on updated_at, so a stale device can overwrite newer data. Consider rejecting a PUT when body.updated_at is older than the stored value.
seed_data_creation: Registered one test_<hex>@aegis.dev user (name TEST_user) for the state round-trip, so the admin's state was not overwritten. It was not deleted because there is no delete-user endpoint.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Smoke suite: /app/backend/tests/test_smoke.py. Not tested: Jev, chat, quiz, OCR, STT, files, media, Google auth, brute-force lockout, frontend.
